Little Herb Places

Brand Identity, Narrative, Web Design

Identity and a direct-to-consumer website for Little Herb Places, a small-batch herbal goods brand.

Visit Little Herb Places

Scope

The founder had spent years developing tinctures, teas, and topicals using herbs she'd grown up with. We gave that existing work an identity and a place to sell it.

Brand Identity

Earthy tones, botanical motifs, and a wordmark with a printed quality carry through the labels, packaging, and website. The handmade character of the products sets the terms.
